name: Payments to public officials to obtain permits or bypass controls
description: Payments are made to officials, rangers or couriers around licences, inspections, reserves, ports or border clearances.
fp: Official fees and per diems can be legitimate and documented.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering from Environmental Crime (2021)
UNEP and INTERPOL, The Rise of Environmental Crime: A Growing Threat to Natural Resources, Peace, Development and Security (2016)
OECD, Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Business Conduct (2018)
FATF, Money Laundering and the Illegal Wildlife Trade (2020)
UNODC, World Wildlife Crime Report: Trafficking in Protected Species (2016, 2020 and 2024 editions)
CITES, Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora

links.name: Payments to officials for permits or to bypass inspections

links.fp: Fees and official services are lawfully paid.
